# Cncf Groundcover Reviewer

Review groundcover using its official documentation and repository in the Observability and Analysis / Observability category. groundcover is a cloud native observability platform powered by eBPF. It runs inside the customer’s cloud and provides complete visibility into applications, infrastructure, networks and AI systems without operational overhead.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
